name: Baitun Najat Jame Masjid
address: ই. এফ. আই ব্লক, শাহজালাল উপশহর, সিলেট।
_eventsSheet: The admins' events tab (আয়োজন) as a published CSV link — same steps as the prayer times. Empty or unreachable = the committed src/_data/activities.csv is used. Columns and rules: src/_data/activities.js.
_prayerSheet: The committee's prayer-times Google Sheet, as a CSV link: in the sheet, File → Share → Publish to web → Comma-separated values → Publish, and paste the link here. Empty, unreachable or incomplete = no prayer times on the site. Layout and rules: src/_data/prayer.js.

social._note: Najat TV channel URLs. A button appears on /media/ only once a URL is set.

bkash._todo: The masjid's general bKash number for /donate/. (a) the number, (b) "merchant" (donor picks Payment) or "personal" (donor picks Send Money) — a wrong instruction loses the transaction. A dedicated masjid account, never a personal one: this goes on a public page. Until set, the card shows TBD, as on the Seerah page.

_naming: SETTLED: BAITUN NAJAT. Supersedes BAYTUN NAJAT (event banner) and baitul-najat (repo slug). Volunteer vests already carry the correct form. Repo directory name is cosmetic and intentionally left alone.
